meta.name: Stingray Classica
meta.description:
Discover breathtaking classical music concerts, operas, and ballets from some of the grandest venues around the world.

Shows: Nikolay Lugansky & Vadim Rudenko, Glenn Gould, Jonathon Heyward & London Symphony Orchestra, Isabel Schwartzbach, Eivør Pálsdóttir & Adam Riis, Soloists of the Lucerne Festival Orchestra
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
